name: Mutton Tallow
imageAlt: rendered pure traditional mutton tallow tail fat in a jar
description: Mutton tallow is an ultra-robust animal lipid matrix characterized by its high thermodynamic stability and dense distribution of saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids. It serves as an intense metabolic fuel and a pristine medium for delivering fat-soluble nutrients with high thermal resistance.
macroIntro: A pure, hydrophobic triglyceride profile isolated from all proteins and carbohydrates.
microIntro: A specialized lipophilic matrix delivering high ratios of stearic acid and natural CLA for structural support.

macroNutrients.name: Calories

microNutrients.description: Monounsaturated fraction supporting endothelial and lipid homeostasis.

microNutrients.name: Conjugated Linoleic Acid (CLA)
microNutrients.description: Ruminant trans-fatty acid isomer linked to immune and lean tissue support.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin E (Alpha-Tocopherol)
microNutrients.description: Lipophilic antioxidant suppressing free radical propagation.

microNutrients.name: Dietary Cholesterol
microNutrients.description: Sterol foundational to membrane synthesis and steroid hormone paths.

healthBenefits: Thermodynamic Stability: High smoke point (~220°C) prevents toxic degradation during cooking.
CLA Delivery: Provides natural CLA for metabolic and immune modulation.
Nutrient Carrier: Optimizes the bioavailability of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K).
Barrier Support: Used historically for protective sealing of skin and mucosa.
Ketogenic Efficiency: Ideal, non-insulinogenic fuel for beta-oxidation.
precautionsIntro: Considerations for digestion and systemic lipid markers:
precautions: Digestive Friction: High melting point (~50°C) may cause heavy gastric sensation if consumed with chilled fluids.
Caloric Density: Extreme energy concentration requires careful portion management.
Lipid Markers: High saturated fat content may affect ApoB/LDL levels in susceptible individuals.
